goal: Implement Slice S6 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (Initiative deepen-authority-seams): the Authority Store exposes one Run-exact read of a Task's settled Run; modules outside runtime/kernel stop reading Run rows; the forwarding readTaskRecord export is removed. No schema or migration change.

acceptance.assertion: Per D6 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (sources U1, E5): runtime/kernel/storage.ts exposes one read that, for a Task in this worktree, returns the settled Run's identity, its identity-validated record, its proof, whether its audit pair is exported, and the raw bytes needed for byte-exact comparison. Positive: a settled Task returns its own Run. Negative: an active Task or a Task with no Run returns null. Bound: for a Task with two Runs the read never returns the other Run's record or proof. Agreed seams: tests/task-record-durability.test.ts, tests/kernel-enrollment-transaction.test.ts.

Per D6 and the prohibited-coupling rule of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md: no module outside plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel imports sqlite_store or reads Run rows; batch reconfirmation, preflight ownership and batch commit use the settled Run read; audit paths in batch_reconfirmation.ts come from storage_paths.ts; the enroll-<task>-<created_at> Run-id convention is defined once. Positive: reconfirmation, own-claim detection and batch commit behave as before. Negative: the boundary test fails when a module outside runtime/kernel imports sqlite_store. Agreed seams: tests/kernel-r2c2-boundary.test.ts, tests/batch-plan-reconfirmation.test.ts, tests/unattended-batch-commit.test.ts, tests/pi-batch-authority.test.ts.

Per D6 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md (source E5, docs/adr/0012 'Remaining coarse-key sites'): the run-blind readAuditTaskPair(root, taskId) reads in storage.ts, assurance_projection.ts and the Pi readSettledTaskRecord are Run-aware. Positive: a re-enrolled Task reads its current Run's evidence. Negative: the stale flat pair of an earlier Run is not returned. docs/adr/0012 lists the corrected remaining sites. Agreed seams: tests/kernel-assurance-projection.test.ts, tests/post-freeze-intent-resolution.test.ts.

Per D6 of docs/specs/deepen-authority-seams.spec.md: the forwarding readTaskRecord export of runtime/kernel/storage.ts is removed and its callers use readTaskRecordRaw; the Kernel index exposes readTaskRecordRaw and not readTaskRecord. The AssuranceCoordinatorPorts member of the same name is unaffected. Agreed seams: tests/kernel-r2c1-boundary.test.ts, tests/kernel-r2c2-boundary.test.ts.

plugins/immune-brain/dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs is regenerated from the changed runtime sources and matches a fresh generate; no hand edit to the bundle. Agreed seam: tests/claude-host-package.test.ts.
